About Wenley

About Wenley.

Wenley Technologies is a Maryland-based small business providing mission support services to federal agencies and prime contractors, spanning program, logistics, cybersecurity, and IT support. Our focus is on clearly defined contract requirements and practical delivery.

Wenley's managing partner is a disabled veteran and logistician with over 25 years of logistics experience, and the company draws on the experience of several disabled veterans who advise on strategy and delivery.
